description: OpenCLI adapters for VTEX Admin (SE Toolkit). Read-only browser adapters for VTEX Admin screens with no usable public API — session-based, works against any VTEX account the operator is logged into. This manifest is a separate ecosystem from .claude-plugin/ (Claude Code skills) — same repo, two independent plugin systems.

vtex-admin.description: Read commands for VTEX Admin screens without a usable public API (starting with B2B authorization dimensions: organizations, cost centers, buying policies).
